LESSON: STORY TELLING – OGRE NARRATIVE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1.1: Story telling – Ogre narrative

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Story telling – Ogre narrative
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why are ogre stories important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information
2. retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication

Teach
• Today’s focus: retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication” using a school example.
• Model B for “retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information
• Model 2: retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information
2. Practise: retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Story telling – Ogre narrative.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are ogre stories important?
2. How can we make a storytelling session more captivating?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the characteristics of a good story teller for information
• retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
